QuestInfo.name: Salad Ingredients
QuestInfo.1:
Camila wants to make a Green Mushroom Salad for Maya who is sick, but she needs you to get the ingredients.

Bring back 10 Green Mushroom Caps and 10 Yellowish Green Mushroom Caps.
QuestInfo.2: You got the ingredients for Maya's Salad and gave them to Camila.\r\n
QuestInfo.0: Camila has a favor to ask you.

0.0: Who are you? Oh, hi. You must be Athena Pierce's friend. I'm so sorry, but I can't show you around town right now. You see... I'm COOKING.
0.1: Maya is a bit sick, and I want to make something to perk her up. Say, can you help me?

yes.0: You're quite nice! I like that. Okay, fresh salad will surely cheer Maya up. 10 Green Mushroom Caps and 10 Yellowish Mushroom caps are just what I need for a colorful salad. Can you get them from #m100020000#?

no.0: Are you busy? Did I bother you too much? Oh no, I ruined everything!

1.0: You sure got some fresh ingredients there, #h0#. Thanks! I'm going to toss these real quick. Can you give me a moment?

yes.0: I'll hurry so Maya can have her salad.

item.0: You can find the salad ingredients in #m100020000#.
